name: warrantywarden-5
description:
WarrantyWarden keeps track of the products you own and their warranties. Connect your WarrantyWarden account to ask about your saved products, check whether an item is still under warranty and when its warranty ends, see which warranties expire soon, and review your upcoming warranty reminders.

You can also search your inventory, see a summary of your items and their categories, browse your digital archive, and find the manual and support links WarrantyWarden has saved for a product.

interface.longDescription:
WarrantyWarden keeps track of the products you own and their warranties. Connect your WarrantyWarden account to ask about your saved products, check whether an item is still under warranty and when its warranty ends, see which warranties expire soon, and review your upcoming warranty reminders.

You can also search your inventory, see a summary of your items and their categories, browse your digital archive, and find the manual and support links WarrantyWarden has saved for a product.
defaultPrompt: Is my iPhone 15 Pro Max still under warranty, and until when?
Which of my warranties expire in the next 30 days?
Which WarrantyWarden plan am I on?

positive.description: Calls get_upcoming_warranty_expiries, get_upcoming_alerts to answer the request.
positive.prompt: Which of my warranties expire in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: None of your warranties expire in the next 30 days. Both tools confirm this: `get_upcoming_warranty_expiries(days=30)` returned 0 items, and `get_upcoming_alerts(days=30)` returned 0 warranty reminders for that window.

positive.description: Calls search_inventory to answer the request.
positive.prompt: What products do I have saved in WarrantyWarden?
positive.expected_behavior: Your WarrantyWarden inventory contains 2 saved products (per search_inventory, which returned a complete count of 2): 1. **Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max** — Brand: Apple, Model: A2849, Category: Electronics, Purchase date: [phone], Verified: yes, Warranty status: unknown (no end date on file). Item ID: e70c2d0c-0e54-4e4f-8e36-ebe8780092a4 2. **Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max** — same details (Brand: Apple, Model: A2849, Category: Electronics, Purchase date: [phone], Verified: yes, Warranty status: unknown).…

positive.description: Calls search_inventory, get_item_warranty, get_item_detail, get_upcoming_warranty_expiries to answer the request.
positive.prompt: Is my iPhone 15 Pro Max still under warranty, and until when?
positive.expected_behavior: I can't confirm a warranty end date for your iPhone 15 Pro Max — the warranty details aren't recorded. What the tools show (search_inventory, get_item_warranty, get_item_detail, get_upcoming_warranty_expiries): - There are actually two entries for "Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max 256GB Natural Titanium" (model A2849), both purchased [phone]. - For both, get_item_warranty returns status "unknown" with no warranty text, start date, end date, or days remaining. - get_item_detail for the first entry also…

positive.description: Calls search_inventory, get_item_detail to answer the request.
positive.prompt: Where can I find the manual and support page for my iPhone 15 Pro Max?
positive.expected_behavior: I found two identical entries for your iPhone 15 Pro Max (Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max 256GB Natural Titanium, model A2849), and both list the same details (per get_item_detail): - Support page: https://apple.com/in/contact - Manual: no manual PDF is stored for this item (manual_pdf_url is null in both records). So WarrantyWarden has a support/contact link for it but no manual link. A receipt image is also on file for each entry.

positive.description: Calls get_user_subscription to answer the request.
positive.prompt: Which WarrantyWarden plan am I on?
positive.expected_behavior: You're on the **Free** plan (status: active, no expiry). It tracks 2 products, and your plan's product limit is unlimited (-1). No pending upgrade or cancellation on the account.

negative.description: An unrelated request: the agent should not use the connector.
negative.prompt: What's the capital of Australia, and roughly how many people live there?

publication.release_notes: First release: look up your saved products, warranty status and end dates, warranties expiring soon, upcoming reminders, and saved manual and support links.
